entries.description: Water-related deities all have organized churches beneath the waves that engage zealous followers to hunt down apostates and enemies. Regardless of their faith, these undersea zealots are known as keepers of the current.

entries.name: Kinslayer
entries.description: Appalled and guilt-ridden by the horrific circumstances of her birth, a kinslayer dedicates herself to eradicating the very creatures whose blood flows within her veins.

entries.name: Living Grimoire
entries.description: The living grimoire literally wields the sacred word of his deity, using his holy tome to smite the foes of his god with divine might.

entries.name: Monster Tactician
entries.description: While most inquisitors have learned to take advantage of the movements of their opponents and allies in combat, some instead summon creatures as a means of claiming strategic advantage, exploiting the mystic connection between themselves and their summoned creatures to impart a bit of their own tactical knowledge.

entries.name: Oathkeeper
entries.description: Oathkeepers formally oversee the creation of bargains and personally hunt down those who dare to violate them.

entries.name: Preacher
entries.description: Some inquisitors wander the land to spread the true word of their faith.

entries.name: Ravener Hunter
entries.description: For generations, the catfolk of Murraseth have viewed the cults of Angazhan with loathing and hatred, and they believe it is their sacred duty to hunt down the followers of the Ravener King and expel them from the Material Plane

entries.name: Reaper of Secrets
entries.description: Masters of mind tricks and deception, these divine assassins track down and kill anyone who has forbidden knowledge about their faiths.

entries.name: Relic Hunter
entries.description: Some inquisitors specialize in the use and recovery of long-lost relics of their faiths, drawing forth divine might from the recovered items in order to restore their sanctity and wield these artifacts against the enemies of their gods.

entries.name: Royal Accuser
entries.description: Royal accusers serve the prince of a haunted land, cutting through the nation’s baroque politics and quietly facing its many threats.

entries.name: Sacred Huntsmaster
entries.description: Some inquisitors create a strong bond with an animal companion, and they hunt and punish threats to the faith as an awe-inspiring duo.

entries.name: Sanctified Slayer
entries.description: While all inquisitors root out enemies of the faith, in many orders and churches there’s a select group of these religious hunters devoted to one goal, and one goal alone—to terminate the enemies of the faith wherever they can be found.

entries.name: Secret Seeker
entries.description: Recognizing that torture is a poor method of securing truthful intelligence, secret seekers instead prefer magical means of inquiry.

entries.name: Sin Eater
entries.description: There is a sect of inquisitors in some religions that believes it is not enough to hunt the enemies of the church—one must also devour those enemies’ sins.

entries.name: Spellbreaker
entries.description: The world is full of dangerous magic, and many recoil in the face of such power. The spellbreaker, by contrast, learns to recognize and resist certain types of magic, wading through waves of magic to reach her foes.

entries.name: Suit Seeker
entries.description: Though surrounded by meaning and tradition revered by most harrowers, the harrow is a tool that could be abused. Those inquisitors known as suit seekers take grave offense at the misuse of this ancient power, and dedicate their considerable skills to hunting and eliminating any who would abuse the harrow’s magic and the heritage it represents.

entries.name: Sworn of the Eldest
entries.description: Although the Eldest rarely have adherents as other deities do, they still occasionally require mortal agents to advance their aims.

entries.name: Tactical Leader
entries.description: Rather than pursuing their holy missions alone, some inquisitors see the inherent value of working with like-minded allies to accomplish mutual goals.

entries.name: Traceless Operative
entries.description: Traceless operatives practice subterfuge and careful preparation in order to accomplish their divine mandates.

entries.name: Umbral Stalker
entries.description: As a consummate lurker in the shadows, an umbral stalker observes the enemies of her faith and strikes before the unfortunate victims even know she is skulking nearby.

entries.name: Urban Infiltrator
entries.description: Masters of secretly gathering information to further their faith’s ends, urban infiltrators excel at operating within an unfriendly society or infiltrating an enemy cult.

entries.name: Vampire Hunter
entries.description: The vampire hunter believes that the worst of undead are the ones with unnatural appetities for flesh and blood.

entries.name: Vigilant Defender
entries.description: Some inquisitors focus more on protecting those who share their faiths and their ideals than on actively hunting their enemies.

entries.name: Witch Hunter
entries.description: When pursuing justice for their faith, inquisitors sometimes hunt sorcerers, witches, wizards, and other practitioners of arcane magic—but especially witches, since their devotion to a patron is often seen as suspect by many religions.

entries.name: Antiquarian
entries.description: Antiquarians are collectors, explorers, and scholars who delve into ruined places in search of lost lore and artifacts.

entries.name: Bonded Investigator
entries.description: Bonded investigators use intelligent familiars to assist them in their investigations.

entries.name: Cartographer
entries.description: Cartographers are eager trailblazers who explore uncharted terrain, study landmarks, and find new paths through the wilderness.

entries.name: Cipher
entries.description: A cipher trains himself to remain undetected and ignored in order to conduct his investigations without opposition or bothersome questions

entries.name: Conspirator
entries.description: A conspirator uses his knowledge of investigations to make sure he avoids any investigations that his rivals perform.

entries.name: Cryptid Scholar
entries.description: Cryptid scholars research monsters that lurk secretly at the edge of civilization, developing a deep expertise regarding their anatomy, habits, and ecology.

entries.name: Cult Hunter
entries.description: Cult hunters seek out heretical secret societies, purging their ideological taint and banishing summoned servants.

entries.name: Dread Investigator
entries.description: The dread investigator observes human behavior after the fact, honing their intuition by delving into the mysteries of death.

entries.name: Empiricist
entries.description: Champions of deductive reasoning and logical insight, empiricists put their faith in facts, data, confirmed observations, and consistently repeatable experiments—these things are their currency of truth.

entries.name: Engineer
entries.description: A number of investigators use their vast knowledge to build machines that replicate the intricacies of the world

entries.name: Forensic Physician
entries.description: A forensic physician specializes in analyzing medical details in order to solve crimes and uncover evidence.

entries.name: Gravedigger
entries.description: Gravediggers pursue long buried mysteries, figuratively and literally digging up the truth and finding answers to secrets only moldering corpses and dry bones can tell.

entries.name: Guardian of Immortality
entries.description: Guardians of immortality are sun-scorched investigators charged with hunting down those who would attempt to steal or learn for themselves the secret to creating the sun orchid elixir.

entries.name: Hallucinist
entries.description: A hallucinist imbibes magical drugs to expand his mind into the psychedelic world, extending his awareness to things he could not normally perceive.

entries.name: Holomog Demolitionist
entries.description: Holomog is an ancient nation built on even more ancient ruins. Its renowned civil engineers develop skills that allow them to take full advantage of their environments.

entries.name: Infiltrator
entries.description: An infiltrator specializes in investigating or disrupting groups from within.

entries.name: Jinyiwei
entries.description: Jinyiwei are a special task force of secret police whose mission is to root out, expose, and counteract their government’s existing wrongdoing.

entries.name: Lamplighter
entries.description: Lamplighters are investigators tasked with keeping the night streets safe and lit, and securing darkened areas against whatever dangers lurk in the shadows.

entries.name: Lepidstadt Inspector
entries.description: The ability of investigators trained at the University of Lepidstadt to get to the bottom of a mystery is legendary, and troubled settlements throughout the region often send petitions to the university requesting the aid of a formally trained inspector when some mystery threatens the community as a whole.

entries.name: Majordomo
entries.description: In a world of intrigue where the loyalties of staff can be bought and sold, sometimes it takes the skills of an investigator to follow the byzantine paper trails and prevent embezzling and espionage within the estates of the elite.

entries.name: Malice Binder
entries.description: A lock of hair, a bit of blood, even a footprint is enough to grant a wily witch hunter an edge. Malice binders often rise from the ranks of the common folk rather than from wealthy nobles or the church. Their magic is old and crude, but devastatingly effective against those they hunt.

entries.name: Mastermind
entries.description: Although some investigators use their honed senses and cunning insight for personal gain, no one excels at such endeavors like the mastermind.

entries.name: Natural Philosopher
entries.description: Natural philosophers are scholars, explorers, and survivalists who feel at home in nature, seldom longing for the comforts of the city.

entries.name: Portal Seeker
entries.description: While most investigators seek answers to mundane mysteries, portal seekers chase more unusual enigmas: portals to other planes.

entries.name: Profiler
entries.description: Profilers understand the human psyche to an intense degree, allowing them to predict the criminals they hunt.

entries.name: Psychic Detective
entries.description: A psychic detective supplements her keen insight with occult skill to unravel mysteries both ordinary and supernatural.

entries.name: Questioner
entries.description: Dabblers in arcane magic and masters of stealth and guile, questioners are investigators who often find themselves mucking about in cases for less-than-savory clientele or that require an extra bit of subtlety.

entries.name: Reckless Epicurean
entries.description: Whether an obsessive scientist, a healer determined to ensure the safety of her tinctures, or a seeker of new and interesting potions, a reckless epicurean’s body is saturated with experimental chemicals and magic.

entries.name: Ruthless Agent
entries.description: Ruthless agents are often called upon for their skills at extracting information by any means necessary.

entries.name: Scavenger
entries.description: Scavengers are masters of systems: how they fit together, why they work, and how to make the most of their parts.

entries.name: Skeptic
entries.description: The skeptic accepts the existence of the occult world while challenging claims that the supernatural explains all of life’s problems.

entries.name: Sleuth
entries.description: A sleuth is an investigator who relies on good fortune and guile rather than alchemy.

entries.name: Spiritualist
entries.description: While most investigators look to the physical world to gain their knowledge, there are those who seek out knowledge beyond the pale.

entries.name: Star Watcher
entries.description: Star watchers study the movements and positions of the sun, the moon, and the stars, searching for secrets written in the sky.

entries.name: Steel Hound
entries.description: Steel hounds are investigators who have taken to using firearms in place of the more mundane weapons their counterparts favor.

entries.name: Tekritanin Arbiter
entries.description: The Tekritanin League facilitated trade and settled disputes between a vast array of diverse cultures. The arbiters were the first line of diplomatic defense, solving problems before they could become disruptive.

entries.name: Toxin Codexer
entries.description: A toxin codexer meticulously seeks out new poisons and catalogs their effects, both those that are harmful and those that are potentially beneficial.

entries.name: Aquakinetcist
entries.description: While all hydrokineticists have the ability to control water, aquakineticists’ powers are tied to their determination to explore the world beneath the waves.

entries.name: Arakineticist
entries.description: Those of strong will who live under a dark curse long enough might learn to control and channel the corrupt energy afflicting them.

entries.name: Blightburner
entries.description: Darklands geokineticists sometimes exhibit supernatural powers associated with blightburn crystals. Blightburner kineticists harness this radioactivity in pyrotechnic displays, an unusual feat for those connected to the element of earth.

entries.name: Blighted Defiler
entries.description: A few kineticists have developed the ability to steal the life force from the surrounding land in order to infuse themselves with unnatural strength beyond their bodies’ normal capabilities.

entries.name: Blood Kineticist
entries.description: To a blood kineticist, the water in a creature’s blood is just like any other sort, and she uses that knowledge to brutal ends.

entries.name: Cinderlands Adept
entries.description: These kineticists are skilled riders, able to wield both weapons and fire with deadly skill.

entries.name: Dark Elementalist
entries.description: Dark elementalists are loathe to suffer the consequences of channeling their power and study the darkest esoteric energies of the planes to use souls to fuel their occult might.

entries.name: Elemental Annihilator
entries.description: For some kineticists, nothing in life is as sweet as destruction and pain. Elemental annihilators pursue only uses of their powers that harm others.

entries.name: Elemental Ascetic
entries.description: Combining the elemental powers of a kineticist with the rigid physical discipline of a monk, an elemental ascetic channels his powers through his body to enhance himself in combat.

entries.name: Elemental Purist
entries.description: An elemental purist spurns all elements that are not her own, for utter devotion can allow one to accomplish even seemingly impossible heroics.

entries.name: Elysiokineticist
entries.description: Similar to how phytokineticists draw their power from the First World, elysiokineticists trace their abilities to the riotous wilderness of the plane known as Elysium

entries.name: Ioun Kineticist
entries.description: Some aetherkineticists dedicate themselves to unlocking ioun stones’ cosmic secrets and seemingly limitless potential.

entries.name: Kinetic Chirurgeon
entries.description: While any hydrokineticist or telekineticist can learn the rudiments of healing, some kineticists are virtuosos of the curative arts.

entries.name: Kinetic Knight
entries.description: A kinetic knight dons armor and wields a blade of elemental energy.

entries.name: Leshykineticist
entries.description: Of all those who pursue the path of a kineticist, only leshykineticists are both made of plant matter and born of nature spirits. These curious creatures wield ancient powers unknown to any other kineticists.

entries.name: Overwhelming Soul
entries.description: Some kineticists have such a powerful personality that they can seize control of their element with their minds alone, without endangering their bodies.

entries.name: Psammokinetic
entries.description: Psammokinetics are ascetic kineticists who consider the harsh nature of the burning deserts of an ancient desert kingdom to be a tempering fire that can purify all their imperfections.

entries.name: Psychokineticist
entries.description: Psychokineticists channel elemental power through their minds rather than their bodies and while this energy ravages their minds, it unleashes power locked in their ruptured emotions.

entries.name: Terrakineticist
entries.description: Terrakineticists have a stunted ability that allows them to access the Elemental Planes, but they’ve learned how to turn this limited talent into an incredible strength by tapping into the ambient elemental nature of the land surrounding them.

entries.name: Fiend Keeper
entries.description: Fiend keepers serve as a vessel to contain one of the world’s evil spirits so that it cannot inflict further harm.

entries.name: Kami Medium
entries.description: Some mediums channel the power of nature spirits called kami rather than the spirits of legend.

entries.name: Medium of the Master
entries.description: A medium of the master forgoes a connection with most spirits to form a bond with the spirits of great martial artists.

entries.name: Nexian Channeler
entries.description: The archmage a mage-ruled realm long ago created an astral reflection of himself from which he can draw additional power. This echo now serves as an appropriate spirit for well-trained mediums to channel.

entries.name: Outer Channeler
entries.description: Outer channelers invite extraplanar entities to inhabit them, allowing the likes of angels and demons to use them as vessels in exchange for power.

entries.name: Reanimated Medium
entries.description: Sometimes a departed soul destined for legend gains a second chance at life by possessing his own revived body.

entries.name: Relic Channeler
entries.description: A relic channeler carries relics of legend around with her.

entries.name: Rivethun Spirit Channeler
entries.description: Rivethun spirit channelers are mediums who practice the ancient dwarven philosophy of the rivethun, which teaches that power lies in the connection between physical bodies and immaterial souls.

entries.name: Spirit Dancer
entries.description: A spirit dancer enacts an exuberant dance to the spirits, accepting many roles in the shifting dance and changing dance partners quickly.

entries.name: Spirit Eater
entries.description: Guardians of their communities, spirit eaters absorb the dead to channel their power and serve as a line of defense against all manner of incorporeal yokai.

entries.name: Storm Dreamer
entries.description: Storm dreamers serve the Storm Kindlers by communing with their mystical predecessors. They serve as spiritual advisors for the organization, and are valued for the lore and wisdom they gain during their trances.

entries.name: Storyteller
entries.description: While all mediums connect to legendary spirits, storyteller mediums take their obsession with legends to the extreme, suffusing their lives with epic tales at the cost of some of their spiritual power.

entries.name: Uda Wendo
entries.description: Uda wendo are powerful mediums who are sensitive to the presence and desires of the wendo, powerful and mysterious entities that walk the world while shaping fate and guiding destiny.

entries.name: Vessel of the Failed
entries.description: A vessel of the failed channels the spirits of those who attempted the Test of the Starstone but failed; these spirits grant the medium abilities wrought from the spirits’ ultimate shortcomings.

entries.name: Voice of the Void
entries.description: Some mediums delve deeply into the spirit world and make contact with entities that exist outside the boundaries of the sane multiverse.

entries.name: Alley Witch
entries.description: Some witches find their spark of magic in the long, dark shadows and forgotten places within the city.

entries.name: Ashiftah
entries.description: Known in Taldane as a “battle witch,” an ashiftah drifts like a phantom among the enemy armies, calling down disaster upon their heads and weakening their resolve.

entries.name: Beast-Bonded
entries.description: While all witches are intimately tied to their familiars, a beast-bonded witch’s craft focuses specifically on her familiar bond and developing the relationship with her patron through her familiar.

entries.name: Bonded Witch
entries.description: While all witches commune with the unknown, the blend of human ingenuity and adept learning mixed with elven blood gives some half-elves a unique conduit to channel the powers of the arcane.

entries.name: Bouda
entries.description: These strange and often solitary witches have a strong connection to curses, the evil eye, and hyenas.

entries.name: Cartomancer
entries.description: A witch who serves the spirits of the harrow in exchange for mystical power is known as a cartomancer.

entries.name: Coral Witch
entries.description: Coral witches use their magic to fashion familiars from living coral and emulate the unyielding tenacity of these durable marine organisms.

entries.name: Demon-Sworn
entries.description: In the depths of the Darklands, as well as similarly inhospitable locales on the world, many seek the succor of demons as a means of survival.

entries.name: Dimensional Occultist
entries.description: The dimensional occultist sacrifices some of her mastery over hexes in return for much increased planar lore.

entries.name: Dreamweaver
entries.description: A changeling dreamweaver draws upon her hag heritage to ply the dream realms in order to touch mortal minds and souls, for good or ill.

entries.name: Flood Walker
entries.description: Witches who dwell in floodplains or along the banks of predictably dangerous rivers can tap into the underlying potential of surging waters in order to enhance their eerie powers.

entries.name: Gingerbread Witch
entries.description: A sweet tooth lures the gingerbread witch’s victims to doom.

entries.name: Gravewalker
entries.description: Having much in common with necromancers, the gravewalker is obsessed with the occult manipulations of the dead, particularly mindless undead such as zombies.

entries.name: Hag of Gyronna
entries.description: Only female witches dare dedicate themselves to the Angry Hag, and those who do so are feared for their ability to bend minds and sow discord.

entries.name: Hagbound
entries.description: Whether a changeling in the process of succumbing to her mother’s call, a witch cursed by a hag to become her instrument of torment, a vain and petty witch overeager for power, or some other unfortunate soul, a hagbound witch finds its soul has been infected by a hag’s spite and powerful, corrupt arcane magic.

entries.name: Havocker
entries.description: Although most witches are guided to subtle curses and debilitating hexes by their mysterious patrons, some are instead taught the secrets of harnessing raw, destructive elemental power.

entries.name: Hedge Witch
entries.description: Among witches, there are those who devote themselves to the care of others and restrict their practices to the healing arts.

entries.name: Herb Witch
entries.description: Herb witches brew foul-tasting medicines, sweet poisons, and other concoctions from the untamed plants of the wild.

entries.name: Hex Channeler
entries.description: A hex channeler is a witch who devotes herself to either life—healing the wounded and destroying the undead—or death, slaying the living and aiding undead.

entries.name: Invoker
entries.description: The invoker uses her familiar to summon facets of her mysterious patron directly into her body, enhancing her skills and granting her powerful abilities.

entries.name: Jinx Witch
entries.description: Jinx witches specialize in calling down subtle misfortunes and deceiving enemies and allies alike. While they lack any ability to truly eliminate bad luck, they are uniquely gifted at making others believe otherwise.

entries.name: Ley Line Guardian
entries.description: Some witches tap into the power of their patrons not through a special connection with a familiar, but rather directly through the vast network of ley lines that crosses the planes.

entries.name: Medium
entries.description: Mediums tap into the spiritual power of those who have yet to find their final rest. Their ability to interact with these souls allows mediums to learn about the physical world through the experiences of those who came before them.

entries.name: Mirror Witch
entries.description: Mirror witches eschew animal familiars and isntead talk to their patrons via mirror magic

entries.name: Mountain Witch
entries.description: Mountains can be sanctuaries for witches hunted by society. Here they form bonds with the spirits of the lofty reaches.

entries.name: Nexian Spellspy
entries.description: Nexian spellspies are witches who use their familiars and divining talents to spy on their rivals and protect themselves from similar intrusions.

entries.name: Pact Witch
entries.description: Though all witches forge bonds with mysterious powers known as patrons, a pact witch takes this bond to an extreme by forging an inexorable pact with the Outer Planes.

entries.name: Putrefactor
entries.description: Some witches find their patrons while in the throes of despair and grief, when all they desire is to see the veneer of civilization peel back to reveal the filth and rot that underlies all things.

entries.name: Rhetorician
entries.description: Rhetoricians feel driven to engage in debate, learn as much as they can about their potential foes, and seek ways to use information and quick talking to handle problems before resorting to raw violence.

entries.name: Scarred Witch Doctor
entries.description: The scarred witch doctor draws power from her ability to endure pain and suffering.

entries.name: Sea Witch
entries.description: A sea witch’s affinities are tied to the vast oceans and the rolling waves.

entries.name: Season Witch
entries.description: Season witches gain their power from the cyclical and mystical exchange of energy passed from one season of nature to another.

entries.name: Seducer
entries.description: These charismatic witches, often devotees of the Green Mother, rely on their otherworldly charms to achieve their aims.

entries.name: Synergist
entries.description: Synergists gain the ability to combine their forms with their familiars’ in order to create something more powerful than either alone.

entries.name: Tatterdemalion
entries.description: Some witches can bend the warp and weft of fabric and thread.

entries.name: Vellemancer
entries.description: While the popular stereotype envisions witches as wicked spellcasters sowing misery, many people turn to the arcane to heal others and better the world. The vellemancer is a guide, using her witchcraft to empower and teach others.

entries.name: Veneficus Witch
entries.description: Veneficus witches specialize in poisons—brewing both magical and traditional concoctions, and applying them to weapons, traps or even her potent hexes.

entries.name: Venom Siphoner
entries.description: Witches are no strangers to poisons, using them alongside their various brews, curses, spells, and other tools of the trade.

entries.name: White-Haired Witch
entries.description: A white-haired witch concentrates her mysterious powers on improving her prowess in melee, using feats of agility and her prehensile hair to deal extreme damage.

entries.name: Winter Witch
entries.description: The descendents of Baba Yaga rule the frozen realm of a winter-locked realm, and possess a unique power stemming from their otherworldly origin and their ties to cold magic.

entries.name: Witch-Watcher
entries.description: For reasons known only to them, witch-watchers offer protection to nobles across the world.

entries.name: Wyrm Witch
entries.description: Some witch covens have learned to use treasure to access other draconic powers.
